description:
Parse assignee text once at the CLI and server boundary, so commands and domain filters carry `Assignee`.

## Background

`executor.query_all` takes its assignee filter as `Option<&str>` (`crates/jit/src/main.rs:1399`). `commands/issue.rs` holds `assignee: Option<String>` at `:40`, `assignee_filter: Option<String>` at `:247`, and `assign_issue` and `claim_issue` take `assignee: String` (`:722,750,799`), and `commands/bulk_update.rs:22` holds `assignee: Option<String>`. `Assignee` is the domain type for this identity, and a query assignee filter that is not one lets a malformed filter match nothing silently.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every command and domain signature, field and filter under `crates/jit/src` that carries an assignee uses `Assignee`.
- [hard] REQ-02: CLI and server assignee text is parsed once at the entry point, and a malformed assignee or assignee filter fails with the existing typed error instead of matching nothing.
- [hard] REQ-03: Serialized issue and event JSON and the CLI's JSON output for valid assignees are unchanged, and `jit --schema` still describes assignees as strings.
title: Commands carry assignees as Assignee
